Die riesen Flasche hält natürlich sehr lange und für das Gesicht z.B. braucht man nicht mal die ganze Menge, die aus dem Pump kommt, zu verwenden. title: Fantastic product
review: I’ve been using the Uriage Face & Body Oil for Dry Skin Prone to Atopy, and it’s honestly one of the best products I’ve found for calming and protecting my skin. My skin tends to be very dry, itchy, and easily irritated, but this oil has made a huge difference.The formula is fragrance-free and soap-free, which is perfect for sensitive or reactive skin. It contains 19% glycerin and shea butter, so it deeply moisturises without leaving a greasy film. After using it, my skin feels instantly soothed, comfortable, and nourished — the tightness and itching fade away almost immediately.I really appreciate how gentle it is — I can use it on both my face and body, even during flare-ups, without any irritation. It also helps maintain hydration throughout the day, especially during cold or dry weather.Overall, this is a fantastic product for anyone with very dry, atopic, or sensitive skin. It restores comfort, reduces itching, and leaves the skin soft and protected. Definitely a must-have for everyday use!
